entities.summary: Goldsworthy Lowes Dickinson, known as Goldie, was a British political scientist and philosopher. He lived most of his life at Cambridge, where he wrote a dissertation on Neoplatonism before becoming a fellow. He was closely associated with the Bloomsbury Group. Goldsworthy Lowes Dickinson was a journalists & chroniclers from London (1862-08-06, London–1932-08-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
